text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Kiseki-chan!
Are you heading to self-training now, too?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, I came to see you today.
...To make a declaration.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan. My story is only gonna
get more interesting from here.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you were in the same place,
in the very same era.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who can produce a race superior to mine
—will never appear, save for myself.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —You have determined eyes, Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Will you get even stronger?
Far more... than me?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...It's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If you're curious about what lies "ahead," come see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'll make your heart pound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I go over the final checks for Kiseki's strategy heading into the Arima Kinen.
This time, we'll adapt the front-running tactic from the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared two more new proposal drafts,
so could you please look over them?
choice_data_list: ...! So you mean picking the real deal between those two?
...! So you mean picking the real deal between those two?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ! No way!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know I can create
an even more interesting piece
than the two I just submitted.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please guide me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I just want to create a great piece of work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those burning eyes urge me to act. I have a premonition... of the masterpiece she will create.
choice_data_list: First, let's review things from the top down!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We work on the manga storyboard Kiseki brought,
hashing it out, refining it, and expanding on it together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As a partner to a creator.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me! Coming through!
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can see everything from here.
...Whatever "it" is you're going to pull off. All of it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer.
What place did I get in the fan vote this time?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Kiseki's question,
I open the results page. There—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sixth place?! After putting on a performance like that... only sixth...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Looks like besides Ai-chan,
there are so many others
I still have to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that make it even more interesting?
choice_data_list: Your battle is far from over.
Your battle is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'd gladly welcome it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It seems it was still too early for us to reach the final chapter.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki! We finally get to run together!
At everyone's Arima! I get to run with you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Blast-chan!
...—Fufufu, you're so right!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I mean, your aura's totally insane too!
Your muscle tone looks super solid...
Just how hard did you prep for this?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai isn't the only one who's gonna shine out there!
Besidesâ

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Miracles aren't the only thing
that can thrill people, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, that's right...!
Me too...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even I! I'm a magnificent Umamusume
who has beaten that Kitasan Black before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand.
Vivlos's older sister, and an Umamusume of Kitasan Black's generation.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a dramatic turn of events!
Please, let me hear the music you play!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we savor together
the sound of countless dreams bursting forth?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth.
A veteran musician from a generation before Kitasan Black and her peers, battling on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This ground is still connected to our era.
Are you prepared for what's to come?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I am your sworn friend of this era,
Satono Diamond!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...So cool.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Cool?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool.
All of you must surely be the "protagonists" too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still—I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't want to lose anymore, either.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what Kiseki's up to today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You never know until the gates open!
That's just how Kiseki races, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I always find myself looking forward to seeing her.
My fave is someone else, but somehow...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: —Show us an incredible race, Kiseki!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if my voice can reach her...
As she exchanges lines with her rivals
within this work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you weren't a die-hard fan,
even if you were a fan of other Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—People filled with anticipation for her race are gathering at the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'm the kind of Umamusume who's always most exciting from here on out.
